name: dbt-copilot
description: Ask questions about a dbt project's lineage, logic and health in plain English.

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:api
scripts.build:api: esbuild server/handler.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --external:@anthropic-ai/sdk --outfile=api/chat.js --banner:js="// Generated from server/handler.ts by npm run build:api. Do not edit by hand."
